gender_policy.defect_resolution_note: Prevents Artefact 2 defect where story-builder fallback defaulted to Kore (female voice). Both characters are grown adult men; differences are physical mass, pitch floor, and leverage, never feminine yield.

intimacy_and_pacing_policy.whisper_guideline: Strictly use low, close-proximity VOICED phonation with vocal body and chest resonance. Continuous unvoiced white-noise whispering is banned as it collapses phonation and causes inter-scene timbre drift.
intimacy_and_pacing_policy.state_isolation: Reset stateful session parameters between scenes to prevent intimate bedroom delivery styles from carrying over into daytime/outdoor scenes.
intimacy_and_pacing_policy.timbre_matching: Maintain consistent adult male vocal identity across scene transitions; adjust projection level while keeping fundamental frequency (< 200 Hz) and chest resonance matched.

archetypes.delivery_style: Slow, measured cadence, quiet physical authority, minimal projection in close scenes, fully voiced.
